revision_note: Docking base (Satechi-style stand/hub replacement) for the Mac mini M4 (2024). Mac mini sits on top in a 2 mm recess (footprint 127x127 mm). Dock height 35 mm with internal M.2 2280 SSD bay (80x22 mm guide rails), front port slot (70x12 mm), rear cable pass-through (90x16 mm), bottom power-button access hole, deck + bottom vents, rounded corners r=8. Two parts: dock body + bottom plate. Built on branch feature/mac-mini-m4-case, not master.
